test_title: PYST 55: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word ‘factual’ in the given sentence and choose the correct option.

The scientist’s hypothesis was based on empirical evidence and rigorous experimentation.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. **"Empirical".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Factual**: (तथ्यात्मक) - Based on facts; concerned with what is actually the case rather than interpretations of or reactions to it.

 
 
• **Example**: His argument is supported by factual evidence.
 
 
 
• **Empirical**: (प्रयोगात्मक) - Based on,
